balance_usd.description: Everything you can spend right now, in dollars: `signup_credit_usd` + `funds_usd` + `manual_credit_usd` (permanent) + every `temporary_credits[].credit_usd` (temporary). `datacircle_meta.balance_usd` on a provider call is this number after the call.

signup_credit_usd.description: Permanent: what is left of the $5 signup credit every workspace gets once. Never expires.

funds_usd.description: Permanent: what is left of the funds you added through Stripe Checkout (`POST /checkout/`). Never expires.

manual_credit_usd.description: Permanent: what is left of the credits Datacircle added to your workspace by hand (a refund, a gift, a deal). Never expires. 0 for most workspaces.

campaign.description: The campaign that gave this credit, by its name.

credit_usd.description: Temporary: what is left of this credit until `expires_at`, in dollars. Also capped by what is left of the campaign's shared budget, so it can drop to 0 before then.

expires_at.description: When this grant expires (ISO 8601): after it, what is left is gone.

temporary_credits.description: Temporary credits: one entry per campaign grant that has not expired yet, soonest to expire first. Empty when you have none. At `expires_at` the entry leaves this list and whatever is left of it is gone.
